items.q: So, you see the environment, I was lucky to fill in with Bob, and Parkstock, and Erickson

ctx.x: I like that trio sound anyway, the, about the best of all. Yeah. Yeah, that trio. And then something, with Erickson. Yeah. He's a wild, wild piano player. Yeah.

So, you see the environment, I was lucky to fill in with Bob, and Parkstock, and Erickson, and I was three all the keys, and I was lucky to fill in with them. Yeah. And it helped me a lot, so I'm telling you.
I think Milky could be a great trombonist if you wanted to be.
